content: Mehn Israel ko koaros ahpw mweselda sang sapwtehn en Sin, re ahpw kin kommoaldi wasa kan me KAUN-O kin ketin kilelehdi re en kommoal ie. Nan Repidim re ahpw uhdi ie oh kauwada imwarail impwal kan, ahpw sohte pihl wasao mehn nimpil.
Irail eri pelianda Moses oh ndaiong, “Komw kanimpilei kiht wasaht.” Moses eri sapeng irail, nda, “Dahme kumwail uhkihong ie? Dahme kumwail men songki KAUN-O?”
Ni ar men nimpildahr, re ahpw lipahnedihada Moses, ndinda, “Dahme komw wahkinkitodo sang Isip? Pwe komwi en kemeikitala, iangahki nait seri oh pil nait mahn akan?”
Moses ahpw kapakap ngidingidiong KAUN-O, patohwanohng, “Maing, dahme I pahn wiahiong aramas pwukat? Re nektehn kostakai ie.”
KAUN-O ahpw mahsanihong Moses, “Kahrehda kaunen mehn Israel kan, oh kumwail kohwei mwohn aramas akan. Wa kohwei omw sokon me ke poakiheki Pillap Nail.
I pahn uh mwohmw wasao pohn Nahna Sainai. Ke pahn poakih paipo, a pihl ahpw pahn kusieisang, pwe aramas akan en nimpilsang ie.” Moses eri wiahda mepwukat mwohn kaunen mehn Israel ko.
Wasao eri adanekihla Massa oh Meripa,
pwehki mehn Israel ko ar kaulim, oh kasongosonge KAUN-O ni ar nda, “KAUN-O ketin ieiang kitail, de soh?”
Mehn Amalek kan ahpw kohdo oh men mahweniong mehn Israel nan Repidim.
Moses eri ndaiong Sosua, “Pilada ekei ohlen, ke ahpw kohwei lakapw oh mahweniong mehn Amalek kan. I pahn uh pohn dohlo, kolokol sokon me Koht ketikihong ie.”
Sosua eri kapwaiada dahme Moses ndaiong, ih eri mahweniong mehn Amalek ko; a Moses, Aaron oh Hur ahpw kohdahla pohn dohlo.
Eri, nindokon Moses kapakapahda peh ko, mehn Israel ko kin pweida nan mahweno; a ni eh kin kadaridi peh ko, mehn Amalek ko kin tapihada pweida.
Ni pehn Moses ko eh daula, Aaron oh Hur ahpw ale takai ehu oh kamwohdangdiong Moses powe, ira ahpw kesikesihnen mpe kolokolada peh ko; lao ketipino kihrla.
Sosua eri kalowehdi mehn Amalek ko koaros.
KAUN-O eri mahsanihong Moses, “Ntingihedi met nan pwuhk, pwe en wia mehn kataman ehu. Ke ahpw kairehki Sosua me I pahn irisasang pahnlahng mwaren Amalek, pwe katamanpe en dehr kin wiawi.”
Moses eri kauwada pei sarawi ehu wasao, me e kihong ede, “KAUN-O iei ei Pilaik.”
E ahpw pil nda, “Kolada pilaik en KAUN-O! KAUN-O pahn kin ketin mahweniong mehn Amalek kohkohlahte!”

footnotes.text: MASSA...MERIPA: Ahd pwukat ni mahsen en Ipru wehwehki “songosong” oh “kaulim.”
